### 2. lig147 ligand plate preparation

Concentration of lig147 PCR1 \= **24.4 ng/uL**

For one 384-well plate with \~25 uL of 20 ng/uL DNA per well ⇒ Total yield needed is 200 ug ⇒ If we set up PCR on a 96-well plate, this scales down to about 2 ug yield per well

Prepare a 1000 uL solution of DNA with 1025 uL of PCR1 ⇒ 25 ng/uL DNA mix

Prepare a 200X reaction mix:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **PCR1 DNA** | **2050** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **5000** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **500** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **500** |
| **Water** | **1950**  |
| **Total** | **10000** |

Split mix into 50 uL per well for two 96-well PCR plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **3X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Use one of the spare PCR reactions for checking the quality and size of the product.  
Pool all PCR product with the previous PCR2 product and measure concentration \= 

### 3. *Hia5* treatment of nucleosome samples

Set up reactions for the following samples (test run):

D4

* 10 uL sample \+ Nuc buffer C (8 uL) \+ 0.5 uL SAM \+ 1 uL 20X Spermidine \+ 0.75 uL Hia5 (1 reaction)

D5\*

* 10 uL sample \+ Nuc buffer C (8 uL) \+ 0.5 uL SAM \+ 1 uL 20X Spermidine \+ 0.5 uL Hia5 (1 reaction)

D6

* 10 uL sample \+ Nuc buffer C (8 uL) \+ 0.5 uL SAM \+ 1 uL 20X Spermidine \+ 0.5 uL Hia5 (1 reaction)

Each 10 uL of the sample should approximately contain b/w 200-300 ng of DNA.

*\*Samples D5-1 & D5-2 were combined*

After Hia5 treatment, add 0.5 uL 10% SDS & 0.5 uL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) in 20 uL reactions and incubate 50 degrees, 15 mins.

Perform clean-up with Ampure XP beads:

- Add 1.5X volume of AmpureXP beads and mix thoroughly. Incubate at RT for 15 mins.  
- Place tubes on magnetic rack and allow liquid to separate from beads for 5 mins.  
- Perform two washes with 80% ethanol (200-300 uL each)  
- Allow the beads to dry for \~30s and then add fresh TE buffer in desired volume for elution. Mix thoroughly and incubate at RT for 5 mins.  
- Place tubes on magnetic rack and allow liquid to separate from beads for 5 mins. Collect separated supernatant as purified DNA sample.

Post clean up take 10 ng of each sample and use for testing with DpnI & MboI digestion.

### 4. Optimisation of ligN40w107 PCR

*![](assets/img/doc3-image3.png)*

At this point determine the overall concentration of the pooled annealed reaction and use this for further PCR optimisation.

Concentration of this annealed ligN20w107 \= 75 ng/uL \[60 uL\]

### 5. NCAP-SELEX Buffer

**Dilution buff: TE buffer \+ 1mM TCEP \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 2mM MgCl2**

500 mL

| TE Buffer (100X) | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 5 mL |
| MgCl2 (1 M) | 1 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 3 tablets |

Mix the buffer and filter and store.

**sol1 Salt solution: 2M KCl\_1.491g KCl \+ 10mL TE \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 1mM TCEP**

50 mL

| KCl | 7.46 g |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 0.5 mL |
| TE Buffer (100X) | 0.5 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 5 tablets |

Mix the buffer and filter and store.

NOTE: Too many tablets of the PI cocktail have been added here. Only 1 tablet needed. Re-prepare this and filter and store. DIscard previous solution.

**Blocking buff (salt free): 25mM Tris, 0.5% BSA, 0.1% tween, 0.02% NaN3 pH8**

Prepare 10% NaN3 solution (0.25 g in 2.5 mL water).

500 mL

| NaN3 (10%) | 1 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tween20 | 0.5 mL |
| BSA | 2.5 g |
| 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8\) | 12.5 mL |

Mix the buffer and filter and store.
